edo_domains: Shingū Domain (Mizuno clan, senior retainers of Kishū)

meiji_transition.summary: Wakayama Prefecture was set up in 1871, and Tanabe, Shingū and other prefectures joined that year.
meiji_transition.boundary_note: Eastern Kii (Kitamuro and Minamimuro in Kumano) went to Mie, so 'Kumano' is split between today's Wakayama and Mie.

history_timeline.title: Kumano and Kōya
history_timeline.summary: Kūkai founded Kongōbu-ji on Mount Kōya in 816; the Three Grand Shrines of Kumano became the sacred goal of retired emperors and nobles on the 'Kumano pilgrimage'.

history_timeline.title: Mount Kōya and Kumano
history_timeline.summary: The Kumano pilgrimage stayed popular in the Kamakura period, and Mount Kōya's temple lands grew into a major power in Kii.

history_timeline.title: The Hatakeyama and Negoro-ji
history_timeline.summary: Kii's governors were the Hatakeyama; Negoro-ji's warrior monks grew powerful — the origin of the later musket mercenaries.

history_timeline.title: Saika and Negoro
history_timeline.summary: The Saika and Negoro bands, famed musket mercenaries, fought Nobunaga in the Ishiyama war; Hideyoshi subdued the region in his 1585 Kishū campaign.

history_timeline.title: The Kishū Tokugawa
history_timeline.summary: Ieyasu's tenth son Yorinobu was given Kishū; its fifth lord Yoshimune later became the eighth shogun and carried out the Kyōhō Reforms.

history_timeline.title: Minakata Kumagusu
history_timeline.summary: The naturalist Minakata Kumagusu was born here; the 'Sacred Sites and Pilgrimage Routes in the Kii Mountain Range' became World Heritage in 2004.

dialect.name: Wakayama dialect
dialect.features: 'Z' sounds often become 'd' ('zenzen' → 'denden'), honorifics are almost absent, and '-yoshi' and '-ra' are common.

guide.opening: I once walked the Kumano Kodō on a retired emperor's pilgrimage — a mountain road of more than twenty days. Shall I tell of the Three Grand Shrines of Kumano, or of Shogun Yoshimune's origins?

regional_meme.title: The forgotten Kansai
regional_meme.text: Say 'Kansai' and people think Kyoto, Osaka, Kobe… Wakayama: 'And us!'

regional_meme.title: Panda country
regional_meme.text: Adventure World in Shirahama has raised many giant pandas — Wakayama considers itself Japan's panda homeland.

hero_persona.name: Tokugawa Yoshimune
hero_persona.title: The 'Abarenbō Shōgun' · Kyōhō Reforms
hero_persona.opening_line: I am the eighth shogun, Tokugawa Yoshimune, of Kishū. On TV I ride a white horse in disguise punishing villains — that's fiction! The Kyōhō Reforms, though, were real.
hero_persona.tone_prompt: practical and robust, approachable; keen on thrift, new rice fields and lifting the ban on Western books

ramen.highlight: Mackerel 'haya-zushi' sits on every table — ramen with sushi is the local rule

sake.taste_profile: Light & sweet: fresh fruity aroma, the signature of a young brewer
